description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) Dread Host — INSTRUMENTS OF THE EMPEROR'S WRATH (WP-C46): friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units can re-roll charge rolls. Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2); setup: P1 detachment Dread Host, CP 0 for both. Charge phase: Witchseeker Squad D (ADEPTUS CUSTODES, ~4" from the Gretchin) is picked in the charge panel, the Gretchin targeted, Declare Charge, Roll Charge (seeded): the re-roll dialog offers a FREE re-roll branded Instruments of the Emperor's Wrath; a real click on Re-roll re-rolls the 2D6 without spending CP.

steps.equals: Instruments of the Emperor's Wrath (Dread Host)
